targets.summary: The custom _static_seq_len helper duplicates what existing inductor helpers already do (checking whether a size is statically known without adding guards); use those helpers instead.
targets.adoption_evidence: Before, the line read `return int(seq_len) if seq_len is not None and isinstance(seq_len, (int, sympy.Integer)) else None`. The merged code deletes the custom `_static_seq_len` helper. At its call sites it now uses inductor's existing sizevars helpers: `sizevars = V.graph.sizevars`, then `if sizevars.statically_known_lt(seq_len, 128):` and `elif sizevars.statically_known_lt(seq_len, 512):`. These check sizes statically without adding guards, which is what the maintainer asked for.
targets.stage3_reason: The hand-rolled `int(seq_len) if ... isinstance(seq_len, (int, sympy.Integer)) else None` duplicates inductor's sizevars helpers and treats every symbolic size as unknown, so the concern is reasonable and a reviewer could spot it. But the shown diff is truncated before this subclass. The only related visible change is the base signature going from `seq_len: Any` to `sympy.Expr`, so I can't confirm `_static_seq_len` was replaced with the sizevars helpers.
